You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Can model CS-400 stay with internal production control after 20 January 2027?

Facts:
[0] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[1] digital instructions, manufacturer — retentionPeriod — make them accessible online during the expected lifetime (for at least 10 years) [condition: after the placing on the market of the machinery or related product] [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[2] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or the related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 10(3)]
[3] technical documentation and EU declaration of incorporation — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[4] relevant technical documentation for partly completed machinery — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex VII]
[5] technical documentation and EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 12(2)]
[6] copy of the EU declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 13(8)]
[7] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product (for the expected lifetime of the machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[8] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Annex VII, 7]
[9] original EC declaration of conformity — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[10] digital EU declarations of incorporation — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[11] copy of EU declaration of incorporation, kept by importers — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the partly completed machinery has been placed on the market] [REG, Art. 14(7)]
[12] digital EU declarations of conformity — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: in any event] [REG, Art. 10(8)]
[13] recorded data on the safety related decision-making process for software based safety systems — retentionPeriod — one year (P1Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[14] manufacturer applying internal production control — hasObligation — it shall design and construct the machinery or related product (it shall design and construct the machinery or related product) [condition: if a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a)] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[15] tracing log of data generated in relation to an intervention and of safety software versions — retentionPeriod — five years (P5Y) [condition: exclusively to demonstrate the conformity of the machinery or related product with this Annex further to a reasoned request from a competent national authority] [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[16] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC — placingAllowedUntil — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6]
[17] manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 — hasObligation — shall apply the internal production control procedure (shall apply the internal production control procedure) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I] [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[18] machinery or related product — requiresProcedure — internal production control (Module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where applicable] [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 9]
[19] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]
[20] copy of certificate, technical file and relevant documents — retentionPeriod — a period of 15 years (P15Y) [DIR, Annex IX]
[21] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 — retentionPeriod — at least 10 years (P10Y) [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[22] Regulation — appliesFrom — 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) [condition: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates] [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10]
[23] Article 50(1) — appliesFrom — 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12]
[24] Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) — appliesFrom — 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14]
[25] manufacturer — hasObligation — the internal measures that will be implemented (the internal measures that will be implemented to ensure that the partly completed machinery remains in conformity) [condition: for partly completed machinery produced in series] [REG, Annex IV, Part B]
[26] machinery category listed in Annex I, Part B — requiresProcedure — internal production control (module A) (internal production control (module a)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B] [REG, Art. 25(3)]
[27] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery — placingAllowedUntil — Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) [condition: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive] [DIR, Art. 27]
[28] category of machinery or related product not listed in Annex I — requiresProcedure — internal production control procedure (module A) (internal production control procedure (module A)) [condition: Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I] [REG, Art. 25(4)]
[29] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — Adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process (adequate account shall be taken of changes in the production process) [condition: changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications, by reference to which the conformity is declared or verified] [REG, Art. 11(4)]

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The facts do not say whether CS-400 falls within Annex I, Part B, so they cannot confirm whether it can stay with internal production control (Module A) after 20 January 2027. Under Article 25(3), Module A applies to machinery categories listed in Annex I, Part B, and under Article 25(4) it applies to categories not listed in Annex I. Fact 16 only allows products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 14 January 2027 to be placed until 20 January 2027, and it does not settle CS-400's procedure.", "used": [16, 26, 28]}
